title: Worked well at first
text: The app was super nice to start off with because I could have all of my outfits organized on the calendar view and have an overview of each month. I’m not sure what happened recently, but at the start of this month I could only see all of my outfits for this month in the overall calendar view and all of my prior months are not accessible on the overview calendar page which makes it very inconvenient when trying to get an overall picture of outfits worn through the month. This feature was working before so not sure what happened.

title: Good for keeping track of your items. That’s it.
text: No logic to the outfits put together. They seem to just grab random tops and bottoms and throw them together. No regard to shape, or style. Let me throw a red and tan cashmere oversized sweater with emerald green corduroy pants and grey ankle boots.

title: Carousel Filters Need Work
text: I really like the app but have found it can be glitchy and not comprehensive in features. The main downside I’ve found is the lack of filters available for the carousel feature (which is the clear highlight of this app over other wardrobe planning!). Specifically, I’d like to carousel my wardrobe based off tags (work etc.) and location. Otherwise it becomes too unwieldy if you have more than a capsule wardrobe to effectively plan your outfits.

title: Accessibility is Lacking for the blind/visually impaired.
text: Cool app, but lack of accessibility really impedes my ability to use it as someone who is legally blind. I use a combination of zoom, voice over, and larger text fonts to utilize my phone… Whering doesn’t adapt to my text sizes and it’s hard to navigate with zoom… however, voiceover is also difficult as there is so much happening.!

title: Great amount of features, but keeps crashing
text: I’ve been enjoying it so far, but everytime I try to style someone’s closet with a lot of items, the app crashes before I can finish the outfit.

title: Whering support team doesn’t respond
text: I used to use this app daily and it was a big help in choosing my outfit for the way. However, I was suddenly kicked out from my account and was not able to log back in despite multiple attempts. This has been an ongoing issue for a whole month and the Whering support team takes weeks to respond to emails, and then just stops replying even after multiple follow up emails. Whering claims they are able to recover your account but after seeing how their support team responds to issues their users have, I will be going to another app. Completely ridiculous.

title: Update is a cash grab
text: I loved this app, I’ve had it for about a year now. I updated it recently and a feature that used to free and the best part, you now have to pay for. Before when you upload a clothing item, the system would automatically clean it up and enhance the photo, now you have to pay for that. So annoying

title: solid app
text: really like the concept of this app! great for planning outfits and tracking what i’ve worn. however, i think there should be a way to manually sort items and outfits within the categories and also in lookbooks. currently, you can only sort it by when you added it (i shouldn’t have to go in and individually re-log hundreds of clothing/accessory items; not to mention this wouldn’t make sense since i will likely eventually upload new pieces), season, or by tags, which i have tried to use but this feature doesn’t work very well and doesn’t sort tags in order either. if this got changed i think Whering’s usability would be much better

title: lots of untapped opportunities
text: great for what it is, but has some weird bugs where not all the clothes will load. i think there’s so many things they could be doing. i’d love to filter specific types of clothing (only see tanks, only see long sleeves, etc.) WISH there’d be a feature to also add hair and makeup to mood board without having to essentially make a pinterest collage. why can’t we archive look books? i don’t need a winter lookbook in the middle of summer, so it’d be nice to hide and re-add later. also, i get the use of ai for editing, but wish yall would cut back where its not necessary and make better sustainable choices internally.
